title: Word-synced captions
description: Short caption chunks that follow the voiceover; the word being spoken is in the accent colour, spoken words turn white, upcoming words are dimmed. A new chunk starts at a pause, a sentence end or maxWords.

words.description: [{w, s, e}] in scene-local seconds, from tools/word_timings.py (subtract the scene start).

maxWords.description: Most words per chunk; 2-4 reads best on phones.

pauseSplit.description: A gap longer than this (s) starts a new chunk.

hold.description: How long a chunk may stay after its last word (s) when no chunk follows at once.

bottom.description: Bottom edge of the captions in px. Keep it at or above ~1500 so the app's own caption and buttons do not cover it.

style.description: pill = dark rounded box, outline = text stroke, plain = nothing behind the words.

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47, e.g. en, tr, de). Sets <html lang>, which drives uppercase rules (tr: i -> İ).

transparent.description: No backdrop, for an overlay render (needs an output format with alpha).

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: textcheck: chunks never overlap and stay above the bottom UI zone
